name: Blender
summary: Makes every agent in the project able to build, check and ship game art in Blender: 6 skills, standing rules, and a background Blender toolchain with renders it can see.
description: Turn it on for a project that keeps .blend files. Every agent launched there gets Blender skills (fundamentals and bpy, game-ready modeling, rigging and skinning, animation, materials and baking, and the Blender-to-Unreal pipeline), the plugin's rules in its brief, and the `blender` MCP server, which runs Blender in background mode on the checkout's files - no Blender window needed: file inspection, Python, renders from any angle and frame returned as images, rig and skin checks, animation measurement (sides, grips, clearance, contacts), FBX export with Unreal's conventions, and a one-step export-import-verify into a running Unreal editor when the Unreal Engine plugin is on too.

mcp_servers.name: blender
mcp_servers.description: Background Blender on .blend files in this checkout: inspect, run Python, render images, check rigs and skinning, measure actions, export FBX for Unreal, and export-import-verify into a running Unreal editor.
